release_notes:
feat: ship favicon set and reference it app-wide

Add the full favicon set (ico + 16/32 PNG + apple-touch + android-chrome +
webmanifest) at the web root so it ships with every install, and add a modern
favicon <link> block (falling back when no custom brand favicon is set) to the
admin, client, storefront and login heads using $BASE_URL. Fixes the missing
favicon and the console 404s.
